row.schema_witness: open dense does not imply comeager
row.why: An open dense U subseteq D is comeager: comeager means containing a countable intersection of open dense subsets, and U equals the one-set intersection of itself. Equivalently D\U is closed with empty interior, hence nowhere dense, hence meager.
row.consequence: Replace the no_transfer claim. If the intended point was that the two notions are not equivalent (the converse fails), reverse the ordered pair: residual_comeager -> open_dense_escape: no_transfer with witness W3 (the irrationals in [0,1] are comeager with empty interior).

second_row_note.issue: witness as written supports residual_comeager -> full_measure; for this direction the correct witness is 'a full-measure set can be meager' (W2: complement of W1).
